player_prompt.intro:
Kai ne Jokkondir {player_id} a wasan Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; kai ka ga kallon karta din abokin hamayya.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) a kowace round, {max_rounds} round(s) gaba daya.
- Kafa kafa: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X shi nambari mai kyau <= adadin katin ka.)
- Mafi girma karta mai boye ya ci pot a lokacin showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Ina jama'a kafa kafa kafa, misali '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', ko '[fold]'.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Wala ko noddata; a waaway [check] ha baagal.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Naftirgo [bet X] ngam maɓɓugo; wala ko ɓeydata.
